setup_audio_pretraining_task: setup an AudioPretrainingTask instance from parsed argparse arguments for audio pretraining
load_audio_dataset_split: load a train, valid, or test audio dataset split from a TSV manifest file
add_audio_task_args: add audio pretraining task arguments like sample rate, normalization, and padding to an argparse parser
encode_audio_labels: encode audio labels into token IDs using a LabelEncoder and fairseq Dictionary
get_target_dictionary: get the target dictionary for audio pretraining labels from the AudioPretrainingTask instance
